title: Philoponus against the resurrection of the body
english: I read John Philoponus's treatise On the Resurrection, in volumes [the number is blank in Bekker]. In it he does away with the resurrection of the body and says a great deal that is ill-considered, mocking our blessed and holy Fathers as well.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824 p.5. Bekker prints lacuna dots after ἐν τόμοις.
Codex 21 of 279; John Philoponus (John the Grammarian) On the Resurrection.
